title: Fine-tuning vision foundation model for crack segmentation in civil infrastructures (CrackSAM)
mechanism: SAM fine-tuned with adapter or LoRA for prompt-free crack semantic segmentation; strong under noise and on unseen crack sets.
adaptation: Benchmark baseline: SAM ViT-B/L adapter at 1024, 24 classes, house loss; report clean-49, E1 and per-source.
min_experiment: Adapter variant inside the TopoLoRA harness vs house PF, 5-fold CV; default kill line.
evidence: R: beat 12 segmentation models on noisy and previously unseen sets; 810 open images (road, wall); 98 citations.
